therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of BCR-ABL driven leukemic cell proliferation and survival
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Response to induction therapy (complete remission rate)

results.effect_size: Complete remission rate: 42/54 (77.8%); Molecular complete remission: 17/54 (31.5%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Molecular complete remission achieved in 17/54 patients (RT-PCR negativity for bcr-abl)
biomarker_changes: RT-PCR negativity for bcr-abl in 17 patients
results.dose_information: Imatinib 600 mg daily days 1-14 for course 1, then 600 mg daily days 1-14 (or daily if tolerated) for subsequent courses, combined with alternating Hyper-CVAD chemotherapy cycles

context.duration: treatment duration not specified, follow-up to 5 years
